warmup.name: Leg Kicks
warmup.description: A dynamic kick where you alternately swing each leg forward and back to open up the hips and warm the muscles. Stand tall with hands on hips or out to the sides, kick one leg forward then sweep it back while keeping the standing leg stable and core braced. Benefits: loosens the hip flexors and hamstrings, raises body temperature, and improves balance and coordination before a workout.

warmup.name: Ankle Roll
warmup.description: A gentle mobility drill that moves the joint through its range to prep the quadriceps, hamstrings and glutes. Perform slow, controlled circles or rocks through a comfortable range of motion. Benefits: lubricates the joint, improves mobility, and reduces stiffness before activity.

warmup.name: Arabesque
warmup.description: A dynamic warmup movement that actively mobilizes the quadriceps, hamstrings and glutes. Perform the motion in a smooth, controlled and rhythmic way, gradually increasing range as the muscles loosen up. Benefits: raises body temperature, lubricates the joints, and primes the quadriceps, hamstrings and glutes for the workout ahead.

cooldown.name: Blackroll
cooldown.description: A gentle mobility drill that moves the joint through its range to prep the lats, traps and upper-back muscles. cooldown.name: Calves foam roller
cooldown.description: A self-myofascial release technique using a foam roller on the quadriceps, hamstrings and glutes. Roll slowly over the muscle, pausing on tender spots for a few seconds at a time. Benefits: eases muscle tightness, improves tissue quality and circulation, and aids post-workout recovery.

cooldown.name: Child's pose
cooldown.description: A gentle cooldown movement that relaxes and lengthens the lats, traps and upper-back muscles. Move into the position slowly and hold or repeat in a controlled, unhurried way, breathing steadily throughout. Benefits: eases tension in the lats, traps and upper-back muscles, supports recovery, and helps bring the heart rate back down after training.
